name: ember-native-unit-test-runner
description: In-app karma test runner shell used by `nativescript test android`/`nativescript test ios`. A Vite/bundle-mode port of NativeScript's own unit-test-runner (Apache-2.0) - the on-device UI and karma wiring are carried over, but the webpack-only `require.context` module registration is replaced with a build-time context generated by `demo-app`'s Vite config, since NativeScript's own unit-test-runner has no Vite support. IMPORTANT for consumers: the `nativescript` CLI hardcodes `node_modules/@nativescript/unit-test-runner/config.js` as the path it writes live test-run connection info to, so this package must always be installed under the dependency name `@nativescript/unit-test-runner` (e.g. `"@nativescript/unit-test-runner": "npm:ember-native-unit-test-runner@^1.0.0"`), never under its own published name directly.
author: Patrick Pircher
